definition: A shape representation whose meaning depends on the assembly context in which it occurs:  it positions the component of an assembly component usage (Acu) within the coordinate frame of that usage's assembly.  Corresponds to the STEP context_dependent_shape_representation, which is the entity that makes the shape of an occurrence dependent on its context, and is why placement is a property of the usage rather than of the component product -- the same product used at several places in an assembly has a different placement at each.
name: ContextDependentShapeRepresentation
